<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#fff">
  <meta name="description" content="A single black circle centered on a white page.">
  <title>Black circle</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: #fff;
    }
    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 90vmin);
      height: auto;
    }
    @media (forced-colors: active) {
      circle { fill: CanvasText; }
    }
  </style>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 2 2'%3E%3Ccircle cx='1' cy='1' r='1'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <svg width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="circle-title">
      <title id="circle-title">Black circle</title>
      <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="#000"/>
    </svg>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I didn't change anything in `0.html`, because it's already in good shape. It's a simple page that shows one black circle centered on a white background, and it already covers the usual things:

- **Setup:** the viewport, description, language and theme-color tags are all there, and the favicon is built into the page.
- **Layout:** the circle stays centered and sized correctly on phones and desktops, including mobile browsers whose toolbars change the screen height.
- **Accessibility:** the circle has a label for screen readers, and it switches to the system text color in high-contrast mode.
- **Scaling:** the circle is a vector image, so it stays sharp at any size and never gets bigger than 400px.

The only thing I'd consider tweaking is a small one: the circle touches the very edge of its box, so on some screens its outer edge can look slightly cut off. Shrinking the radius a little (say to 199) would fix that.

Is there something specific you'd like instead? For example:
- a dark mode that turns the page black and the circle white
- animation, such as a pulse or a gentle scale-in
- making it interactive, like changing on hover or following the cursor
- a different look: a gradient, a shadow, or a different size
